title: Traditional British Shepherd's Pie
description: A classic British dish made with ground lamb, vegetables, and mashed potatoes. It's a hearty and comforting meal that's perfect for cold weather.
instructions: In a large pan over medium heat, cook the ground lamb until browned, breaking it up into small pieces as it cooks.
Add the chopped onion and carrot to the pan and cook until the vegetables are softened.
Sprinkle the flour over the lamb mixture and cook for 1 minute.
Gradually add the beef broth, whisking continuously, and bring the mixture to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer for 10 minutes.
Meanwhile, boil the chopped potatoes in a large pot of salted water until they are tender.
Drain the potatoes and mash with butter, milk, and salt and pepper to taste.
Transfer the lamb mixture to a 9x13 inch baking dish.
Top the lamb mixture with the mashed potatoes.
Bake in the preheated oven for 25-30 minutes, or until the potatoes are golden brown.
